newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB still making sure Swiss market stays liquid.
newsitem.headline: SNB still making sure Swiss market stays liquid.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) said it would continue to make sure that the Swiss money market would remain very liquid, a spokesman said.
"We will continue to take care that the money market remains very liquid," an SNB spokesman said in response to enquiries.
He added that the level of sight deposits had not changed significantly in the latest reporting period.
The SNB has generally been generous in adding funds to the Swiss money market.
In the last few days the SNB has refrained from adding liquidity, but money market rates have still fallen from recent highs as there are enough funds in the market, traders said.
